_comment: Follow-up to param_ranges_bgsub.json (bgsub_sweep1, 18 real records, see data/simulation/bgsub_sweep1_leaderboard/summary.txt). Findings driving this revision: (1) varThreshold=16 (pipe-lhs-0001-42) had a perfect 18/18 pass_rate but by far the worst area_tolerance_violation_rate (0.43 vs 0.09-0.24 for everything else) and n_roi_violations (~96/record vs mostly single digits) -- textbook plan.md degenerate-optimum: trivially clears the >=3-movement-event bar while apparently tracking noise outside the ROI a lot of the time, not the animal. Dropped entirely rather than kept as a low-end sentinel. (2) varThreshold 32-80 was the only genuinely clean cluster (zeta ~0.98-1.0, area_violation 0.09-0.15, roi_violations often ~0), but we don't have resolution on exactly where the 16->32 transition stops being degenerate, nor whether pass_rate's slight dip at 80 (0.83 vs 0.94 at 32-64) continues past 80. (3) bg_history showed no measurable separation across 2000-6000 in sweep1 -- winners and near-winners were spread across the whole range -- so this revision spends far less of the pipe budget confirming that null result and reallocates it to varThreshold resolution.

_fixed_params.note: Fixed in the base pipeline (pipelines/pipe-v4-base-sweep6.json), not varied here. Only 'values' arrays in this file are actually applied by pipe_config_gen -- a bare 'value' key is not read by the generator, so these must be baked into the base pipeline JSON, not just documented here.

pipeline.gaussian_kernel_size.rationale: sweep-5: weak but consistently unfavourable trend; k=3 was tightest/lowest violin

pipeline.gaussian_sigma_x.rationale: sweep-6 base default -- not swept here, this campaign is bg-subtraction-only

pipeline.bg_var_threshold.rationale: 16 dropped (degenerate on real footage -- see _comment). 20/24/28 added to resolve exactly where the transition out of degenerate territory happens. 96/112 added to check whether the mild pass_rate dip already visible at 80 in sweep1 keeps growing (real detectability limit) or was just single-run noise across only 18 records.

pipeline.contour_min_area.rationale: Was fixed at 15 (sweep-4's pick, on the grounds of 'no measurable effect' -- that check was against synthetic data with a much larger, cleaner synthetic blob). On real footage, min_area=15 combined with the varThreshold range here filtered out essentially every real contour (0.1mg animal's real contour is small and noisy) -- that's what forced a fallback to an older, lower min_area/varThreshold pipe-v6 config to get any detections at all last time. Swept jointly with varThreshold now instead of assumed independent, since the interaction (not either param alone) is what broke detection. 1 is deliberately included as a near-no-filter floor to bound the other end.

pipeline.bg_history.rationale: sweep1 showed no measurable separation across 2000/3000/4000/5000/6000 -- kept as a 3-point confirmatory check (not dropped outright, since only 18 records so far) rather than a full 5-point re-sweep, freeing budget for varThreshold resolution above.
